nora (Acme CISO): Hey all, security wants a short write-up for the POC that covers: how audit logs are captured and exported, key management (KMS), who will have console/API access, and proof we can revoke keys quickly. POC scope: 60 days, sample traffic ~ 200 rps. Prefer Splunk + 1yr retention.

olivia (AE): Thanks @nora. Tagging @harry and @lina to confirm tech and timeline. We can support both Hosted+export and Dedicated.

harry (Sales-Eng): Quick notes: Hosted + export is fastest (minutes). Dedicated pool needs entitlements + ~5 business days for network + quota. Pricing depends on instance class and throughput. I can send a provisional cost estimate after we know expected token/sec and concurrency.

lina (Security): For the questionnaire: we will provide a canned artifact bundle: SOC2 link, KMS integration doc, audit schema, and a sample sanitized JSONL export. Key points to call out: auth events (login, SSO), API key lifecycle (create/rotate/revoke), admin ops (role changes, pool updates), and export events (delivery to target). Full request/response bodies are not part of the standard audit export unless you opt-in to payload logging.

olivia (AE): @nora can you confirm Splunk HEC URI and whether you prefer HEC direct or S3 archive?

nora (Acme CISO): HEC direct preferred. We'll provide HEC endpoint + token. Need the schema ahead of time so our SIEM team can map fields.

harry (Sales-Eng): Got it. Example Splunk config we use on our side (sanitized):

```
audit_export:
  method: splunk_hec
  url: https://splunk-acme.example.com:8088/services/collector
  token: <redacted>
  batch_size: 500
  format: json_lines
  include_fields: ["event_type","user","key_id","resource","action","timestamp"]
```

We also support S3 archive (KMS-encrypted) for long-term retention. If you want 365-day retention we recommend S3 + lifecycle rules on your side.

lina (Security): We'll produce a field-level spec like: event_type, actor, actor_id, key_label, action, object_type, object_id, result, timestamp, audit_event_id. Example event:

```
{"event_type":"api_key.rotate","actor":"admin@example.com","key_id":"k_123","action":"rotate","timestamp":"2026-01-10T15:02:03Z","audit_event_id":"ae_9876"}
```

Note: payloads are redacted by default.

nora (Acme CISO): Can you also show proof of revocation? We need an example revocation call + the resulting audit entry.

lina (Security): Sure. Revocation curl (console API):

```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/keys/revoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>" \
  -d '{"key_id":"k_123"}'
```

The audit event produced looks like:

```
{"event_type":"api_key.revoke","actor":"admin@example.com","key_id":"k_123","timestamp":"2026-01-10T15:05:21Z","audit_event_id":"ae_9877","details":"revoked via console API"}
```

We can provide a signed manifest for exported archives on request.

harry (Sales-Eng): Operational note: for POC dev teams we create scoped API keys with labels so you can filter POC traffic (header X-Client-Tag: acme-poc). Example request header:

```
Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>
X-Client-Tag: acme-poc
```

Those labels appear in the event.actor or key_label fields in exports.

devops-bot: Provision request queued: job=provision-temp-92011 type=dedicated-spot ETA=38m

nora (Acme CISO): If we go Hosted with Splunk export, who has access to the console during the POC? We need a roster template.

lina (Security): We'll send a roster template (CSV) you can fill with names, emails, and roles (console/API). Minimum: two engineers + one security lead. We'll only grant the roles you specify; default is least privilege.

harry (Sales-Eng): Also: if you require VPC/private deployment for egress control, that adds ~10 business days. Let us know ASAP if that's non-negotiable.

nora (Acme CISO): Hosted + Splunk export preferred for speed. We'll proceed with that. I'll DM HEC creds + roster by EOD.

lina (Security): I'll upload a sanitized sample JSONL and the field spec to our shared drive once the creds arrive. We'll also include a short statement confirming immediate revocation capability and retention behavior.

devops-bot: Provision job started: job=provision-temp-92011 status=in_progress pool=dedicated-provision-92011

harry (Sales-Eng): I'll follow up with a preliminary POC quote (pro-rata) and options for switching to Dedicated or Private later.

olivia (AE): Scheduling a 30-min security walkthrough tomorrow 11am PT to review artifacts. @nora please accept. :calendar: \

nora (Acme CISO): Accepted. Thanks everyone.

devops-bot: Provision job completed: job=provision-temp-92011 status=success pool_id=dedicated-92011 ephemeral=true

lina (Security): Uploaded artifacts: https://files.redwood.ai/shared/acme2-sample.jsonl (sanitized) and a field-spec doc. I'll also attach the SOC2 pointer in the email thread.

harry (Sales-Eng): Closing loop here after the call. Action items: olivia -> meeting invite; nora -> HEC + roster; lina -> artifacts + revocation example; harry -> POC quote. :white_check_mark:
